title: Quick QR pairing build 16 verified and ready to install
summary: Signed Android 1.0.14/build 16 includes either-phone scanning, explicit one-use QR authorization, lost-reply recovery and viewer reload recovery. 28 automated tests pass; physical two-phone acceptance remains untested.

changes.detail: Either idle phone can open Scan a phone directly and become the viewer. Owner taps Allow QR connection on the sharing phone to grant one scanner screen/control access without a second approval tap. Separate random QR capability expires after two minutes and is revoked when hidden, replaced, used or stopped.
Return non-authentication status codes for rapid taps, paused streaming and a locked screen, so the viewer does not revoke a valid session. Reject scanning the same phone.
Flashlight and camera retry; viewer reload retry with same-origin in-memory token restoration after WebView process loss, without persistent token storage.
Repair QR translations, update recovery guidance, and prepare version 1.0.14/build 16. Preserve manual owner approval and Android capture permission.
Retry a lost QR join reply up to three times with the same random attempt. Only that attempt, code and peer can recover the existing token; a different scanner cannot reuse it.
Signed arm64 APK and two-phone installation/acceptance guide.

validation.name: App/viewer/history checks
validation.detail: 18 focused tests passed. TypeScript and focused ESLint passed. Initial JSX/state-effect lint findings and remembered-address test expectation were corrected before the final build.

validation.name: Native server tests
validation.detail: 10 JVM tests passed, zero failures/errors. Includes owner-approved one-use QR, hide/replace/expiry revocation, manual approval, duplicate join recovery, explicit stop, 24-hour idle/pause recovery, peer/origin restrictions and rapid-tap throttling.

validation.name: Android build
validation.detail: Final Gradle build returned exit 0: BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m 30s, 855 tasks. Existing Gradle and manifest warnings remain.

validation.name: APK and credential verification
validation.detail: Signature verified and matches build 11. Version 1.0.14/code 16; arm64, camera, native QR consent and join recovery are packaged. All changed native sources match staging, viewer assets match workspace, history report included, stopWithTask=false, no microphone permission. All 1403 ZIP entries pass known-value/pattern/private-file credential audit; unknown or encoded secrets are outside scope. SHA256 b0c2698061d6e1633c61acf796020a394ae5cd63a789e39c97cfe4d1c724e210.

validation.name: Physical acceptance and deployment
validation.detail: No ADB phones connected; actual camera scans, VPN recovery, Recents and overnight operation not tested. Either phone scans the sharing phone; no reverse-invitation QR on an idle viewer. Android capture revocation/lock/process termination/reboot and rotation can stop sharing. Viewer app restart loses in-memory token; persistent initial-join failure may require re-pairing. Offline Disconnect may require Stop on host. No deployment/OTA. This post-build verification report is in workspace history for a future build.
